This '''pin-up of a Human in a jumpsuit''' was a decorative [[Painting/Legends|poster]] available on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The image depicted a [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="Lethal" /> [[Gender/Legends|female]]<ref name="Trivia">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/lethal-trackdown-trivia-gallery|text="Lethal Trackdown" Trivia Gallery|quote=The nightclub on Coruscant is filled with posters of various female pin-up models}} {{C|Slide 6}}</ref> clad in an [[Color/Legends|orange]], tight-fitting [[Jumpsuit/Legends|jumpsuit]], white headgear and small shoes.<ref name="Lethal" />
